label: Op Ghazab, jour 211 — jour 9 117 ; le Pakistan reprend ses frappes aériennes transfrontalières, les IBO au Baloutchistan font 19 morts
source: ISPR / Dawn / Geo News / Daily Pakistan / US News / Amu TV / IANS — September 23, 2026
delta: Sep 21: Pakistan resumes cross-border airstrikes into Nurgal (Kunar) and Barmal (Paktika) for the first time since the June 28-29 Chamkani-Gyan-Marawara package, ending a ~3-month pause — Pakistan claims 28 'terrorists and suicide bombers' killed incl. a suicide-bomber training center; Afghan officials say 3 civilians (same family, incl. 1 woman) killed and 4 wounded in a Nurgal residential home, no casualties in Barmal. Taliban spokesman Zabihullah Mujahid condemns the strikes as 'aggression' and vows an 'appropriate response'; none carried out as of Sep 23. Sep 21-23: ISPR reports 19 militants (Fitna al-Khawarij/Fitna al-Hindustan) killed in Balochistan IBOs — 13 in a Shaban, Quetta clearance operation, 6 in Quetta West/Kech (Turbat) raids; Subedar Muhammad Jamil, 39, killed in action, the operations' lone security force fatality. Sep 18-19: the Kohat Police Lines mosque bombing death toll finalized at 31 (16 police, 7 civilians, 8 attackers); Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan (Hafiz Gul Bahadur-linked TTP faction) claims responsibility. No formal ceasefire, no Urumqi Round 2 meeting confirmed; conflict remains in active escalation with cross-border strikes resumed and a still-unfulfilled Taliban retaliation threat hanging over the theater.
